title: Eetrikunst / The Art of the Ether
license: no licence notice; ETV/ERR archive, all rights reserved implied
notes: Estonian, made for ETV's 25th birthday and about the electronic image itself: the prop store under music; Hagi Šein alone against a huge blue chroma cloth, then composited standing among the ruins of Pirita monastery, into the EETRIKUNST title over a sound bed; a camera panning across the station's own hand-lettered programme title cards; an excerpt of the video play Soolo tornikellale; director Jüri Tallinn on electronic design with a chroma tree behind him; and the long window — the engineers' explosion of the tree into glitter, then one face lit several ways as a voice names each (horror light, mysterious light, light full of inner drama).
